BiblicalUsage: Horonaim is a town in Moab where the fugitives flee and the cry of destruction is heard. Isaiah sees the fugitives fleeing to Horonaim, and Jeremiah hears the cry of destruction in Horonaim and the weeping going up the ascent of Luhith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Horonaim is the sound of a nation running from judgment, and the prophets make us hear it so that we will turn back. I hold that the cry in Moab is the warning for every people that forgets God.
